milestones.title: MarketPulse & Hackathons
milestones.description: Developed MarketPulse, a full-stack trading ecosystem. Participated in the 7th Edition HSIL Hackathon in collaboration with Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

milestones.title: Advanced Full-Stack Development
milestones.description: Built Wanderlust, a full-stack travel listing platform following MVC architecture with robust authentication and Joi schema validation.

milestones.title: Real-Time Video Platform
milestones.description: Developed Connectify, a real-time video conferencing platform using WebRTC and Socket.io for live communication and meeting management.

milestones.title: Started B.E. Journey
milestones.description: Joined KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur for a B.E. in Computer Science specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.
